page.notes: The served restriction page is static HTML/CSS, but the architecture and templates of the intended Casino Plus site could not be determined. Coverage was planned for the homepage plus listing, game/detail, authentication/account, and primary play/deposit journeys; all were excluded only because no routes could be discovered through the restriction wall.
